corrections.why: T1S-R4E is a township and range survey label printed on the Forest Lookouts page, not an agency; the 1959 news report quoted there names the Florida Forest Service's fire watch station.

sources.title: Fla. Fire Towers Being Sold Off
sources.publisher: Firehouse (carried a WFTV report dated July 3, 2010)

notes_for_editor: Build year, 80-ft height, the 1959 station and the 2009 auction all come from one hobby site quoting newspapers; two web searches found no independent record of the 2009 sale. The Firehouse (WFTV, July 2010) piece is statewide context for towers being sold off, not a Wacissa source. The record's agency 'T1S-R4E' is a survey label and is corrected above. The 1959 report also describes a fatal shooting at the station; the story omits the incident and all names because it adds nothing to the lookout's history. The OSM point still carries 'still present?'. A Jefferson County recreation page (search snippet only, not fetched) uses 'Wacissa Tower' for a cycling stop and is not a fire lookout; not used. Record elevation 56 m matches OSM.
